import seaborn as sns

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Create a figure and axis object
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))

# Create a bar chart to show sleep duration by gender

ax.set_title('Sleep Duration by Gender')
ax.set_xlabel('Gender')
ax.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
plt.legend(title='Gender')

# Create a violin plot to show physical activity level by sleep quality
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.violinplot(x='Quality of Sleep', y='Physical Activity Level', data=data)
plt.title('Physical Activity Level by Sleep Quality')
plt.xlabel('Sleep Quality')
plt.ylabel('Physical Activity Level')
plt.legend(title='Sleep Quality')

# Create a scatter plot to show daily steps by heart rate
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.scatterplot(x='Heart Rate', y='Daily Steps', data=data)
plt.title('Daily Steps by Heart Rate')
plt.xlabel('Heart Rate (bpm)')
plt.ylabel('Daily Steps')
